column1: # Curated human antigen panel for EpitopeScope benchmarking.
# One protein per row, resolved to a single-chain PDB file by datasets/build_panels.py.
# Order is meaningful: rows 1-10 are the pilot panel, 1-48 the half plate, 1-96 the full plate.
# Homologous families are deliberately spread across all three scales so that cross-talk has
# something real to find at every panel size.
